To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the COX-2, COX- 1 and 5- LOX channels of arachidnic acid metabolic pathway are not equally significant and the drugs that inhibit these channels have varying side effects.
the relative availability of the substrate to COX-2, COX- 1 and 5- LOX channels of arachidonoic acid metabolic pathway depends upon the relative affinity of enzymes towards the common substrate.
aspirin, dicofenac and indomethacin inhibit COX-1 more than COX-2, while celecoxib is more specific for COX-2 inhibition and zileuton is a specific 5-LO inhibitor.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the appraisal of the differential availability of aranchidonic acid and drugs to COX1, COX2 and 5LOX enzymes.
the differential availability of archidonc acid and anti-inflammatory agents to COX-2, COX- 1 and 5- LOX enzymes.
the appraisal of differential availability of AA and anti-inflammatory drugs in the three channels of arachidic acid metabolic pathway.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the 5-LOx channel is more sensitive to AA and hence more significant in the biological system than the COX-2 channel.
aspirin and diclofenac have more chances of side effect than indomethacin and celecoxib, while zileuton is the least likely to cause side effects among all the four drugs.
the 5-LO channel has the highest affinity for arachidonyl moiety followed by COX-1 channel and COX-1 has the lowest affinity among the three.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the COX-2 channel of arachidonate pathway has the highest metabolic significance, whereas the COX- 1 channel of the pathway has the least metabolic significance.

the relative affinity and expression levels of the three enzymes are responsible for the relative availability of the substrate (AA) to each enzyme and the differential production of metabolites by the three enzymes.

the relative expression of the three enzymes and the relative affinity of each enzyme towards arachidonic (the substrate) are the key factors that decide the metabolic significance of the channels of the arachidonic pathway and hence, the biological outcome.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the COX-2 channel is the least active of the three channels and the COX-3 enzyme, if exists, is not active.
aspirin, dicolfenac, indommethacin and celecoxib can cause side effects like gastrointestinal problems and renal failure, whereas, zileutin can cause bronchospasm.
aspirin, indomethacine and zileuton have the potential to inhibit the activity of 5-LOx, COX- 1 and COX -2 enzymes, respectively, and therefore, they may cause adverse effects on the body.
